step_by_step_reasoning: Data originates from global tire manufacturing factories (OnPremDC) streaming into Kafka (MSK), which feeds into EMR for real-time processing and batch ETL (self-loop). Processed data is stored in S3 and Aurora, with S3 data queried by Redshift via Spectrum. Downstream consumers include BI Reports (querying S3 and Redshift), Real-Time Apps (querying Aurora), and External Systems (querying Aurora/Data layer).
